entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-06
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Lscache integration in MSBuildWorkspace #85941
  • `ITypeSymbol.AllInterfaces` is always empty for type parameters, contradicting its documentation ("the effective interface set of a type parameter") #85937
  • IDE0051/IDE0052 silently skip every member of a type that contains stackalloc #85934
  • Ref conditional operator with a ref-returning function pointer call returns a ref to a copy #85932

Closed

  • Collection initialization with `MatchCollection` produces CS0029 #85912
  • Closing tag completion can eat other parts of the document #85709
    18.12
  • IDE0051/IDE0052 silently skip every member of a type that contains stackalloc #85933
  • Add an option to include numeric type suffixes in TypedConstantExtensions.ToCSharpString #84704
    18.11

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix race between FBP loader and LSP both opening a document #85942
    VSCode
  • Add closed modifier to type in switch expression IDE diagnostic/code action #85940
    Community, VSCode
  • Update developing on windows docs #85939
    Community
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Community

Merged

  • Remove unused Razor content type constants #85928
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Fix close tag completion replacement ranges #85710
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Reuse ToList lowering for single spreads into mutable list interfaces #85777
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality, Feature - Collection Expressions, Next
  • Publish Microsoft.NET.ProjectData.Tasks to vs-impl #85938
    Next
  • Fix LanguageServer Telemetry Reading #85936
    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3097034 #85927
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Add type suffix options to TypedConstant formatting #85830
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #85931
  • Prevent odd document Uris from causing inadvertent syntax errors #85886
    Area-Razor, Next

Updated

  • Fix nullable analysis for reassignment to a union value #85879
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Emit correct IL for exhaustive switch statements that use a separate Dag for lowering #85873
    Area-Compilers, Feature - List Patterns, Feature - Unions
  • Avoid quadratic namespace declaration lookup #85923
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Bound local test partitions and collect hang dumps across platforms #85849
  • Switch to Microsoft.VisualStudio.HotReload.Components services #85672
    VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: require annotation for layout with pack or size #85921
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Remove LSP service factory and simplify structure #85832
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Unsafe evolutions: require AllowUnsafeBlocks for the safe keyword #85784
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Fix Find References for partial members seen through a retargeting assembly #85844
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Verify semantic symbols in using expression tests #85847
  • Handle missing symlink privileges when running a test locally #85919
  • Avoid emitting unexpected indirect load instruction in release mode #85929
    Area-Compilers
  • Split local and Helix test runners #85859
